findings.class: measured claim false outside its unstated scope (dash form survives to round 47 in run artifacts and to round 52 in this page's own text)
findings.skill_statement: At C5 the dash form `<lane>-r<round>-<token>` is not last committed at round 36. Two independent committed counterexample families exist in the C5 tree: (1) run artifacts - `/tmp/tameshi-r45-ExecRows01` (`.ufo/waves/round-45/w1-dispatch.json`, 1693 occurrences at prefix r45 alone), `.ufo/evidence/round-46/deciding-run.sh:20` `WORK=${4:-/tmp/tameshi-r46-deciding}`, `.ufo/evidence/round-47/deciding-run.sh:19` `WORK=${4:-/var/tmp/tameshi-r47-deciding}`, `.ufo/evidence/round-45/freshness/integrate.py:4,22` `/tmp/tameshi-r45-ExecRows*/`; dash-form trees at rounds 37-47 total 3702 occurrences (3654 under `/tmp/`, 48 under `/var/tmp/`), so the form's last committed occurrence in run artifacts is round 47, not 36. (2) The page itself - at the round-52 head `7ff81a5:SKILL.md:25` read ``- **Scratch namespace is `/tmp/<lane>-r<round>-<n>-*/` from the first write**`` and `:136` read ``Scratch for a sweep: `/tmp/<lane>-r<round>-<n>-work/` (Standing rules).``, with `:158,342,543,599` carrying the same dash form, so the page's own dash-form prescription was committed through round 52. The clause is true only under the narrower reading its counts imply but do not state - committed paths under the default base `/fast/scratch/hyaku/tameshi-r<NN>-<token>`: there the census is rounds 25(9), 27(2), 29(101), 31(1027), 32(1508), 33(382), 34(1034), 35(1716), 36(155) = 5934, max round 36, and 0 for rounds 48-52. Reproduction: `git -C LANE grep -o -E '/tmp/tameshi-r[0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_]+' C5 -- .` (rounds 37-47 nonzero, 3702 total), `git -C LANE grep -o -E 'hyaku/tameshi-r[0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_]+' C5 -- .` (max round 36), `git -C LANE show 7ff81a5:SKILL.md | sed -n '25p;136p'` (dash form committed at round 52). The neighbouring clauses reproduce and hold: 0 dash-form path trees for rounds 48-52 in every base, slash form `/fast/scratch/hyaku/tameshi-r<NN>/<sub>` present in each of rounds 48-52 (282/576/4810/2251/148), thousands in aggregate (8067).
